items.title: Oil prices rise, Brent settles above $90 a barrel for first time in over a week
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oil prices rose more than 2% on Wednesday, with Brent settling above $90 a barrel for the first time in over a week. The advance came after Iran-backed Houthis said they had attacked a key Saudi Arabian refinery and amid renewed attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz, countering signs of rising crude supply.

items.title: European gas bucks energy sell-off as lingering cold snap offsets crude slump
items.summary: Investing.com - European wholesale natural gas prices bucked a broader energy sell-off on Tuesday, climbing higher as updated weather forecasts pointed to a prolonged cold snap across the continent, even as crude oil sank to three-month lows on mounting expectations of a global supply surplus.
